A_stem_rewrite.notes: S861 demonstrated: 15 direct stem/explanation edits per wave, ~10 cascade items inherit upgraded labels through rotation-group clones. Cascade benefit (~67% lift) depends on intact rotation groups; remediation waves may have broken some groups.

B_net_new.notes: S899 Phase 1: 13 Analyze + 7 Evaluate. Each item requires concept design, business scenario, stem, 4 choices, all 4 EW fields, EC, and full metadata. Evaluate items (~1/hr) are the binding constraint.

C_relabel.reason: S862 anti-inflation safeguards forbid label-only upgrades without content change. Classification correction (items already at Analyze/Evaluate but mislabeled) is permitted — see Bucket 1.

bucket1_relabel.method: Classification correction: verify cognitive demand is genuinely Analyze/Evaluate, update CognitiveLevel metadata only.

bucket2_upgradable.method: Stem rewrite (Pathway A): convert calculation stems to diagnosis stems. Cascade benefit partial.

bucket3_replacement.method: Net-new authoring (Pathway B): replace definition-match items (DL-031 pattern) with new Analyze/Evaluate items.

verdict.minimum_throughput_increase_required: 2-3x wave frequency (1→3 waves/week) OR 30% increase in items-per-wave
alternative_acceleration_levers: Prioritize Analyze over Evaluate (close 60% of gap in ~15 waves)
